name: @deniai/run-worker
description: Deni Run worker: the job scheduler (routines, stale-lease recovery, job claiming) and, behind RUN_DISCORD_ENABLED, the Discord bot

scripts.build: esbuild src/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node26 --outfile=dist/worker.mjs --packages=bundle --external:playwright-core --external:playwright --external:zlib-sync --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --external:@discordjs/opus --banner:js="import { createRequire as __runCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __runCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
